## `neuro.object.groupBy`

Static method on `Object`.

> Groups members of an iterable according to the return value of the passed callback.

## Signatures

```ts
groupBy(input: { items: Iterable<T>; keySelector?: (item: T; index: number) => K; prompt?: string }): Promise<Partial<Record<K, T[]>>>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Object.groupBy` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
